mainEntity.name: How much does a minicab from Edgware HA8 to Heathrow Airport cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard saloon from Edgware HA8 to Heathrow starts from £58, fixed at the point of booking with no additional charges once the journey is complete.

mainEntity.name: How long does the journey from Edgware HA8 to Heathrow by minicab take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The typical Edgware HA8 to Heathrow minicab journey takes between 40 and 60 minutes via the A5 southbound to Staples Corner connecting to the A406 North Circular westbound and then the A40 Western Avenue westbound toward the Heathrow terminal approach roads, covering approximately 17 miles.

mainEntity.name: Do LTR Minicab drivers offer meet and greet at Heathrow for Edgware HA8 passengers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Our meet and greet service positions your driver inside the arrivals hall with a name board, ready to assist with luggage directly to the vehicle. 45 minutes of complimentary waiting time is included on every airport booking.

mainEntity.name: Are LTR Minicab drivers serving Edgware HA8 fully licensed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Every driver holds a valid TfL private hire licence and all vehicles are maintained and insured to private hire standards.

mainEntity.name: Can I book a fixed price Edgware HA8 to Gatwick or Luton minicab?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Every Edgware HA8 to Gatwick or Luton minicab booking through LTR Minicab is priced upfront and stays fixed regardless of traffic conditions on the day.
